title: Alma meets the sons of Mosiah
summary: While journeying southward from Gideon toward Manti, Alma meets the sons of Mosiah traveling toward Zarahemla and rejoices to see them.

title: The mission's difficult purpose
summary: The account describes the Lamanites' violence, plundering, and idolatry, and explains that the sons of Mosiah hope to bring them to repentance and the plan of redemption.

explicit_facts.text: The Lamanites are described as hardened and ferocious, delighting in murdering, robbing, and plundering Nephites, and seeking riches without labor.
Many worship idols; the text says the promises of the Lord are extended to them on conditions of repentance.
The sons of Mosiah undertook the work hoping to bring the Lamanites to repentance and knowledge of the plan of redemption.

reasonable_visual_inferences: No specific visual scene is required; these verses describe and explain the mission rather than narrate a particular encounter.
unspecified_visual_details: Any particular Lamanite individuals, raid, idol, or missionary interaction.
